CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.chat_report_queue()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'sender_name',r.sender_name,'body',r.body_snapshot,'reason',r.reason,'created_at',r.created_at,'status',r.status) order by r.created_at),'[]') from private.chat_reports r where (private.line_client_access_allowed() or exists(select 1 from public.chat_messages line_source where line_source.id=r.message_id and line_source.origin<>'line')) and exists(select 1 from public.company_members m where m.company_id=r.company_id and m.user_id=auth.uid() and m.role::text in ('owner','admin'))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.content_review_moderator(p_kind text, p_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(
  select 1 from private.content_reviews r where r.kind=p_kind and r.content_id=p_id and private.company_content_review_enabled(r.company_id) and r.review_required and private.content_reviewer(r.company_id))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.chat_report_queue()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ select private.chat_report_queue() $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.report_chat_message(p_message uuid, p_reason text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ select private.report_chat_message(p_message,p_reason) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.review_chat_report(p_report uuid, p_hide boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ select private.review_chat_report(p_report,p_hide) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.content_review_queue()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('enabled',private.content_review_enabled(),'items',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(item order by changed,id) from (
  select r.updated_at changed,r.content_id id,
   jsonb_build_object('kind',r.kind,'id',r.content_id,'revision',r.revision,'state',r.state,'content',private.content_review_payload(r.kind,r.content_id)) item
  from private.content_reviews r where private.company_content_review_enabled(r.company_id) and r.state='pending' and r.review_required and private.content_reviewer(r.company_id)
   and private.chat_sender_visible(r.author_id)
  order by r.updated_at,r.content_id limit 50
 ) items),'[]'::jsonb))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.content_review_queue()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ select private.content_review_queue() $function$
